items.title: Newsom Signs Bills Meant to Prevent Trump’s Interference in Midterms
items.author: Laurel Rosenhall
items.content: <article>Gov. Gavin Newsom of California signed legislation that would make it illegal to interfere with ballots or election records in response to efforts by the president to restrict voting.</article>

items.title: Creating a Kill Switch to Shut Down a Rogue A.I. Is Harder Than It Sounds
items.author: Dylan Freedman and Dustin Volz
items.content: <article>A bipartisan group in Congress and Gov. Gavin Newsom of California have floated ideas for building a mechanism that would instantly power down an A.I. system. Only no one really knows how.</article>

items.title: At DraftKings, AI Targets the Gamblers Likeliest to Lose
items.author: Alex Klavens, Walt Bogdanich and Jenny Vrentas
items.content: <article>Data science helps determine who receives betting incentives, but the company has resisted using similar technology to protect gamblers at risk of addiction.</article>

items.title: ‘Nervous and Skeptical,’ Greenlanders Question the New Deal With Trump
items.author: Jeffrey Gettleman and Maya Tekeli
items.content: <article>The U.S. president’s threats to seize Greenland left its people on edge, and with details scarce, the news of an agreement didn’t seem to be putting minds at ease.</article>

items.title: Behold the Most Handsome Melons in Mexico
items.author: James Wagner and Luis Antonio Rojas
items.content: <article>In the eastern city of Xalapa, what started as a joke among friends over two decades ago has become a vibrant annual tradition that highlights creativity and absurdity with melons.</article>

items.title: Aaron Sorkin Goes Off Script
items.author: Lulu Garcia-Navarro
items.content: <article>The Oscar-winning writer returns to Facebook with “The Social Reckoning”— and surprises us with the revelation of why he is so drawn to uplift and romance. </article>

items.title: Trump’s Security Deal With Greenland: What to Know
items.author: Maya Tekeli, Lynsey Chutel and Amelia Nierenberg
items.content: <article>President Trump insisted for months that the Danish territory should be part of the United States. Now, a security deal — not a takeover — seems to be on the table.</article>

items.title: Has Trump Lost Touch With Reality?
items.author: Michelle Cottle, David French, Michelle Goldberg and Jillian Weinberger
items.content: <article>Three Opinions writers debate whether the president’s recent behavior is really that different from what we’ve seen from him over the years.</article>

items.title: Inside the Breakdown of U.K.-Israel Relations Over West Bank Settlements
items.author: Aaron Boxerman, Adam Rasgon and Stephen Castle
items.content: <article>British officials believed Israel had said it would hold off on moving ahead with construction in E1, a piece of land viewed as vital to a future Palestinian state. Israel said it promised no such thing.</article>

items.title: Trump and Xi Can Make Progress on A.I.
items.author: Nicholas Kristof
items.content: <article>Xi is in the driver’s seat, reflecting American weakness, but there still may be some space for limited advances.</article>

items.title: Fading Light
items.author: Melissa Kirsch
items.content: <article>Fall officially begins on Tuesday, but evidence of the season seeps in more gradually.</article>

items.title: A.G. Sulzberger: The Story of America, Told in 15 Million First Drafts of History
items.author: A.G. Sulzberger
items.content: <article>The Times has witnessed the country’s transformation. It will keep its eyes open.</article>

items.title: Tell Us What Questions You Have About Winter Getaways and Holiday Travel
items.author: Deborah Dunn
items.content: <article>It isn’t too early to start thinking about end-of-year travel plans. We’re fielding reader questions about where to go and what to do.</article>

items.title: Share the Times Pages You Couldn’t Throw Away
items.author: The New York Times
items.content: <article>The New York Times has been publishing for 175 years. Some of that history may be sitting in a shoe box under your bed.</article>

items.title: How Trump Is Wielding Power to Stifle Speech
items.author: Jim Rutenberg and Maggie Haberman
items.content: <article>President Trump has harnessed agencies across the government to curtail press freedoms, a sweeping campaign that free speech advocates say will have lasting effects.</article>
